Packet Routing

Data sent over the Internet is broken into small chunks called packets. Each packet contains source & destination IP addresses. Routers read these headers to determine the optimal next-hop link.

TCP vs UDP

TCP guarantees delivery through handshakes, ordering, and acknowledgments (web, email). UDP prioritizes speed without delivery verification (streaming, gaming).

OSI Layers

  • L7 Application: HTTP, DNS
  • L4 Transport: TCP, UDP Ports
  • L3 Network: IP Routing
  • L2 Data Link: MAC, Switches
